_about: Questions 3-5: style, then the dimension, then the look. Each look lists the styles it is offered for, so every style has looks made for it: Explainer teaches (diagrams, or a 3D world acting it out), Animated tells a story (2D pictures or 3D). A look with "planned": true is not offered yet.

chalkboard.label: Chalkboard / Diagrams
chalkboard.hint: diagrams, arrows, labels and equations that draw themselves (Manim)
chalkboard.styleLock: chalkboard explainer: clean diagrams, arrows, labels and equations drawn step by step on a dark board, one idea at a time
chalkboard.characters: no characters: diagrams, shapes and labels
chalkboard.motion: each part draws itself in time with the voice; flat or 3D diagrams per shot

painted.label: Realistic painting
painted.styleLock: painterly 2D illustration, not a photograph, realistic proportions and faces, soft brush texture, cinematic light
painted.motion: camera moves, 2.5D parallax, kinetic text, 3D inserts

cartoon.label: Cartoon (Pixar-like pictures)
cartoon.styleLock: stylized 3D animated feature film still, appealing cartoon proportions, soft rounded shapes, expressive faces, warm cinematic light
cartoon.motion: camera moves, 2.5D parallax, kinetic text, 3D inserts

aimotion.label: 3D animated (AI motion)
aimotion.hint: Pixar-like pictures brought to life with AI motion (FLUX.2 klein + Wan 2.2)
aimotion.styleLock: stylized 3D animated feature film still, modern CG animation look, appealing cartoon proportions, soft rounded shapes, expressive faces, soft global illumination, warm cinematic light
aimotion.characters: anchor pictures + cut-outs, then each shot animated by Wan
aimotion.motion: full AI motion per shot (Shorts: every shot; long videos: key shots, the rest camera moves)

toy3d.label: 3D Lego / toy world
toy3d.hint: smooth 3D toy figures that walk, jump, talk and show feelings (no AI pictures)
toy3d.styleLock: smooth 3D toy world (Lego V5): soft rounded clay-toy characters with human proportions and clear expressions, rigid objects kept crisp, soft studio light, contact shadows, miniature diorama sets
toy3d.characters: 3D figures built in code from the cast list
toy3d.motion: full: walk, run, jump, sit, point, head-first turns, anticipation, breathing, blinking, expressions, camera moves, fire and particles

diagram.label: Diagrams
diagram.hint: diagrams that draw themselves (Manim), no characters

2d.label: 2D
2d.hint: AI pictures with camera moves, 2.5D and motion graphics

3d.label: 3D
3d.hint: real 3D-film look with moving characters (AI motion), or a Lego-style toy world
